name: replication timing regulatory factor 1
pathways: telomere maintenance in response to DNA damage

function.text: RIF1 encodes telomere-associated protein RIF1. It participates in telomere maintenance and telomere maintenance in response to DNA damage.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

function.text: RIF1 encodes telomere-associated protein RIF1. Based in part on similarity, it is a key regulator of TP53BP1 that plays a key role in the repair of double-strand DNA breaks (DSBs) in response to DNA damage: acts by promoting non-homologous end joining (NHEJ)-mediated repair of DSBs. It is also required for immunoglobulin class-switch recombination (CSR) during antibody genesis, a process that involves the generation of DNA DSBs. It promotes NHEJ of dysfunctional telomeres.
